api-resources.rationale: Prints supported API resources on the server without modifying anything.

api-versions.rationale: Prints supported API versions on the server without modifying anything.

apply.rationale: Applies configuration to create or update resources on the cluster; reversible via subsequent operations or deletion.

apply edit-last-applied.rationale: Opens editor to modify last-applied-configuration annotations on server resources.

apply set-last-applied.rationale: Updates the last-applied-configuration annotation on resources to match file contents.

apply view-last-applied.rationale: Displays the last-applied-configuration annotation; no modification occurs.

auth.rationale: Inspects authorization information without modifying cluster state.

auth can-i.rationale: Checks and reports whether an action is permitted; inspects RBAC rules without modifying.

auth reconcile.rationale: Creates missing RBAC objects and updates existing roles/bindings to match input specifications.

auth whoami.rationale: Displays current user identity and group attributes; inspection only.

cluster-info.rationale: Displays cluster addresses and service information without modification.

cluster-info dump.rationale: Gathers and outputs cluster state, resource info, and pod logs to stdout or directory for inspection.

config.rationale: Modifies kubeconfig files to configure kubectl access; effects are reversible.

config current-context.rationale: Displays the currently active context name from kubeconfig.

config delete-cluster.rationale: Irreversibly removes a cluster entry from kubeconfig; destructive operation.

config delete-context.rationale: Irreversibly removes a context entry from kubeconfig; can affect the current-context.

config delete-user.rationale: Irreversibly removes a user entry from kubeconfig; destructive operation.

config get-clusters.rationale: Lists clusters defined in kubeconfig; inspection only.

config get-contexts.rationale: Lists contexts from kubeconfig; inspection only.

config get-users.rationale: Lists users defined in kubeconfig; inspection only.

config rename-context.rationale: Modifies context name in kubeconfig and updates current-context if the renamed context is active.

config set.rationale: Modifies individual values in kubeconfig file, bounded and reversible.

config set-cluster.rationale: Modifies cluster entry in kubeconfig, bounded and reversible.

config set-context.rationale: Modifies context entry in kubeconfig, bounded and reversible.

config set-credentials.rationale: Modifies user entry in kubeconfig, bounded and reversible.

config unset.rationale: Removes values from kubeconfig file, bounded and reversible.

config use-context.rationale: Changes active context in kubeconfig file, bounded and reversible.

cordon.rationale: Marks nodes as unschedulable to prevent new pod scheduling; reversible with uncordon.

create.rationale: Creates new Kubernetes resources from configuration; resources can be deleted or replaced.

--dry-run.rationale: Validates the object without persisting it to the cluster.

create clusterrole.rationale: Creates cluster role resource in the cluster, standard bounded operation.

--dry-run.rationale: Validates the object without persisting it to the cluster.

create clusterrolebinding.rationale: Creates cluster role binding in the cluster, standard bounded operation.

--dry-run.rationale: Validates the object without persisting it to the cluster.

create configmap.rationale: Creates config map resource in the cluster, standard bounded operation.

--dry-run.rationale: Validates the object without persisting it to the cluster.

create cronjob.rationale: Creates cron job resource in the cluster, standard bounded operation.

--dry-run.rationale: Validates the object without persisting it to the cluster.

create deployment.rationale: Creates deployment resource in the cluster, standard bounded operation.

--dry-run.rationale: Validates the object without persisting it to the cluster.

create ingress.rationale: Creates ingress resource in the cluster, standard bounded operation.

--dry-run.rationale: Validates the object without persisting it to the cluster.

create job.rationale: Creates job resource in the cluster, standard bounded operation.

--dry-run.rationale: Validates the object without persisting it to the cluster.

create namespace.rationale: Creates namespace resource in the cluster, standard bounded operation.

create poddisruptionbudget.rationale: Creates a new pod disruption budget resource, modifying cluster state but reversibly.

create priorityclass.rationale: Creates a new priority class resource, modifying cluster configuration but reversibly.

create quota.rationale: Creates a new resource quota, modifying cluster resource limits but reversibly.

create role.rationale: Creates a new RBAC role resource, modifying cluster permissions but reversibly.

create rolebinding.rationale: Creates a new role binding, modifying cluster RBAC assignments but reversibly.

create secret.rationale: Creates a new secret resource, modifying cluster state but reversibly.

create service.rationale: Creates a new service resource, modifying cluster networking state but reversibly.

create serviceaccount.rationale: Creates a new service account, modifying cluster identity state but reversibly.

create token.rationale: Generates an ephemeral authentication token without creating persistent cluster resources.

delete.rationale: Permanently deletes Kubernetes resources from the cluster; irreversible without backup restoration.

describe.rationale: Shows detailed information about resources without modifying them.

diff.rationale: Compares current configuration with what would be applied; displays differences without making changes.

drain.rationale: Evicts or deletes pods from a node, causing workload disruption; irreversible without pod recreation.

edit.rationale: Modifies Kubernetes resources via an editor and applies changes to the cluster; effects are reversible.

events.rationale: Displays cluster events without modifying any state.

exec.rationale: Executes arbitrary commands in containers, which can modify container state or read container contents.

explain.rationale: Retrieves and displays documentation about Kubernetes resource fields from the server without modifying any state.

get.rationale: Displays resources and their properties from the cluster; purely a query operation with no modifications.

kustomize.rationale: Builds Kubernetes resources from a kustomization.yaml file and outputs the result without applying to the cluster.

logs.rationale: Retrieves and displays logs from containers in pods; read-only inspection of existing state.

patch.rationale: Modifies resource fields on the server using strategic merge patch, JSON merge patch, or JSON patch.

port-forward.rationale: Establishes a temporary port-forwarding tunnel to access a pod without modifying any cluster resources or state.

rollout.rationale: Manages resource rollouts through operations like undo, restart, pause, and resume which modify cluster state but are reversible.

rollout history.rationale: Displays deployment rollout history without modifying cluster state.

rollout pause.rationale: Pauses a deployment preventing further updates, modifying its state but reversibly.

rollout restart.rationale: Triggers a new deployment rollout, restarting resources but reversibly.

rollout resume.rationale: Resumes a paused deployment, re-enabling reconciliation but reversibly.

rollout status.rationale: Displays current rollout status and watches progress without modifying cluster state.

rollout undo.rationale: Rolls back to a previous deployment revision, modifying active resources but reversibly.

scale.rationale: Modifies the number of replicas for deployments, replica sets, and stateful sets.

top.rationale: Displays CPU and memory usage metrics for cluster nodes or pods; read-only inspection of resource consumption data.

--no-headers.rationale: Only affects output formatting; does not modify state.

--selector.rationale: Filters displayed nodes by label selector; does not modify state.

--show-capacity.rationale: Changes which metrics are displayed (Capacity vs Allocatable); does not modify state.

--sort-by.rationale: Only affects output ordering; does not modify state.

-l.rationale: Filters displayed nodes by label selector; does not modify state.

top node.rationale: Displays node resource metrics (CPU/memory usage) without modifying any cluster state.

--all-namespaces.rationale: The 'all' in --all-namespaces expands the scope of what metrics are displayed across namespaces, not what is deleted or destroyed; 'top' is purely a read/display command with no side effects.

-A.rationale: Expands query scope to all namespaces; still only reads metrics, does not modify state.

top pod.rationale: Displays pod resource metrics (CPU/memory usage) without modifying any cluster state.
